scope: Atomic accuracy first; evidence-guided bounded actions, never a highest-level certificate
selection_order: Reject invalid evidence, unchanged-source failures and incomplete oracle gates
Stop radial scans when three distinct ns cases establish a stable unresolved operator defect
Partition the complete signed effective operator by retained core-hole count
Compare two explicitly changed whole-transverse Hamiltonians to their own complete FCI
Emit the unresolved implementation frontier when available distinguishing experiments are exhausted
invariants: Keep original gates and complete physical spaces
Reuse immutable source-bound integrals instead of rebuilding radial data
Use public integral ABI and Bloch oracle; scheduling never owns physics
Record estimates separately from measured timing; finite diagnostics use one CPU
No repeated identical source/input/action job, no arbitrary generated commands, no automatic scientific-pass promotion
